summaryZh: Bennett 实验室研究细胞如何合成、维持和降解蛋白质，以及蛋白质稳态网络如何应对遗传与环境压力。研究结合分子、遗传、系统层面方法和全局定量蛋白质组学，探索泛素依赖的质量控制及促进健康衰老的机制。
researchQuestions: 细胞如何建立、维持和降解蛋白质，并在遗传或环境压力下重塑蛋白质组？
topics: 蛋白质稳态与蛋白质组重塑
methods: 分子、遗传与系统层面研究
全局与定量蛋白质组学

evidence.quote: The Bennett Lab studies the fundamental principles of how cells build, maintain, and destroy proteins . Our research aims to define mechanisms that can be leveraged to promote healthy aging and combat human aging-associated disorders.

The research group utilizes integrated molecular, genetic, and systems-level approaches to examine mechanisms that catalyze proteome remodeling. We employ global and quantitative proteomic platforms that enable systematic analyses of protein homeostasis. These platforms enable studies aimed at detailing how the proteome responds to both genetic and environmental challenges to proteostasis.
Ubiquitin Biology Identifying and characterizing ubiquitin-dependent mechanisms that regulate cellular quality control pathways
